cover.title: The ghost that was blamed for a death

lines.text: This spirit bragged that it killed a man.
1817. Adams, Tennessee. A farmer named John Bell sees a strange animal in his cornfield. He shoots at it. It vanishes.
Then the knocking starts. On the walls. On the doors. Night after night.
The family said invisible hands pulled their hair and slapped their faces. Especially his daughter, Betsy.
Then came a voice. It sang hymns. It repeated sermons word for word. And it swore it would kill John Bell.
People came from all over to hear it. The legend says even Andrew Jackson rode out to see it... and left by morning.
December 1820. John Bell dies. A strange little bottle is found by his bed. The voice takes the credit.
Historians can't find records from the time. The story was written down decades later. But in Adams, people still believe it.
There's a cave on the old Bell farm. Today it's open for tours... and visitors say they've heard knocking. And voices.
Would you go in? Comment not the cave... and sleep tight, partner.
